connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.5: declare per-title availableVariants (the app's audio picker only appears when this metadata is present) — mapped from the source's own dub flag (1->dub, 0->sub) via replaceFirst transforms. Each AnimeUnity entry carries one audio variant, so the app now auto-plays the correct one instead of defaulting to Sub on ITA-only titles; the streams marker gating stays as the honest guard.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
